votes.sql:
SELECT co.order_id,
       s.staff_name AS staff_name
FROM Customer_Orders AS co
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS sda
     ON co.order_date >= sda.date_assigned_from
    AND (sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL OR co.order_date <= sda.date_assigned_to)
JOIN Staff AS s
     ON sda.staff_id = s.staff_id;

SELECT c.customer_name,
       s.staff_name,
       o.order_date,
       o.order_status_code
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customer_Orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Staff AS s ON o.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE o.order_date = (
        SELECT MAX(o2.order_date)
        FROM Customer_Orders AS o2
        WHERE o2.customer_id = c.customer_id
    );

WITH RecentOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_status_code,
        s.staff_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC) as rn
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON oi.product_id = ps.product_id
    JOIN Supplier_Addresses sa ON ps.supplier_id = sa.supplier_id
    JOIN Staff s ON sa.address_id = s.staff_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_name,
    staff_name,
    order_date,
    order_status_code
FROM RecentOrders
WHERE rn = 1

WITH recent_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM "Customer_Orders" o
)
SELECT s."staff_name" AS staff_name,
       r."order_date" AS order_date,
       r."order_status_code" AS order_status_code
FROM recent_orders r
JOIN "Staff" s ON r."staff_id" = s."staff_id"
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r."customer_id";

votes.sql:
WITH cust_stats AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_value,
           AVG(p.product_price) AS avg_price,
           MAX(co.order_date) AS last_order_date
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id,
           cs.customer_name,
           cs.total_value,
           cs.avg_price,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.staff_id ORDER BY cs.last_order_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Staff s
    CROSS JOIN cust_stats cs
)
SELECT staff_id,
       customer_name,
       total_value,
       avg_price
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY staff_id, rn;

WITH Staff_Customer_Orders AS (
    SELECT 
        s.staff_name,
        c.customer_name,
        c.customer_id,
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date
    FROM Staff s
    INNER JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id
    INNER JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
    INNER JOIN Department_Stores ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
    -- Note: Schema does not have explicit staff-customer relationship
    -- Assuming potential mapping through store/customer location would be needed
    CROSS JOIN Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Address ad ON ca.address_id = ad.address_id
    INNER JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
),
Ranked_Customers AS (
    SELECT 
        staff_name,
        customer_name,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY staff_name 
            ORDER BY order_date DESC
        ) as rn
    FROM Staff_Customer_Orders
),
Selected_Three AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Ranked_Customers
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
Order_Metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        stc.staff_name,
        stc.customer_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price), 0) AS total_order_value,
        COALESCE(AVG(p.product_price), 0) AS avg_product_price
    FROM Selected_Three stc
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Orders co ON stc.customer_id = co.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY stc.staff_name, stc.customer_name
)
SELECT 
    staff_name,
    customer_name,
    total_order_value,
    avg_product_price
FROM Order_Metrics
ORDER BY staff_name, total_order_value DESC;

WITH staff_orders AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id,
           s.staff_name,
           co.order_id,
           co.order_date,
           c.customer_name
    FROM Staff s
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON s.staff_id = co.staff_id
    JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY staff_id ORDER BY order_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM staff_orders
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT staff_id, staff_name, order_id, order_date, customer_name
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT
    t.staff_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(t.customer_name, ';') AS three_most_recent_customer_names,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS total_monetary_value,
    AVG(p.product_price) AS average_product_price
FROM top3 t
JOIN Order_Items oi ON t.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY t.staff_id, t.staff_name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.staff_name AS full_name,
                s.staff_gender AS gender
FROM Staff s
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc ON ds.dept_store_chain_id = dsc.dept_store_chain_id
WHERE dsc.dept_store_chain_name = 'East'
  AND (sda.date_assigned_from <= '2018-12-31'
       AND (sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL OR sda.date_assigned_to >= '2018-01-01'))
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Customer_Orders co
        WHERE co.order_date >= '2018-01-01'
          AND co.order_date < '2019-01-01'
    );

votes.sql:
SELECT dsc.dept_store_chain_name
FROM Department_Store_Chain dsc
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON dsc.dept_store_chain_id = ds.dept_store_chain_id
JOIN Departments dept ON ds.dept_store_id = dept.dept_store_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Staff_Department_Assignments sda
    WHERE sda.department_id = dept.department_id
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM Product_Suppliers ps
        JOIN Order_Items oi ON ps.product_id = oi.product_id
        JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
        WHERE co.customer_id IN (
            SELECT ca.customer_id
            FROM Customer_Addresses ca
            WHERE ca.address_id IN (
                SELECT sa.address_id
                FROM Supplier_Addresses sa
                WHERE sa.supplier_id = ps.supplier_id
            )
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM Products p
            WHERE p.product_id = oi.product_id
            AND LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%red jeans%'
        )
    )
);

The question asks for:

- `Staff` table → `Staff_Department_Assignments` → `Departments` → `Department_Stores`

```sql

FROM (subquery finding top 5 products) 
JOIN Products p ON ...
CROSS JOIN Staff s;
```

1. **CROSS JOIN with Staff**: This creates a Cartesian product pairing ALL staff with ALL top products (75 rows = 5 products × 15 staff), not actual assignments

The query fails because it creates artificial staff-product pairings through CROSS JOIN when no such relationship exists in the database. votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    st.staff_name,
    su.supplier_name,
    p.product_name
FROM Staff st
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON st.staff_id = sda.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
CROSS JOIN Product_Suppliers ps
JOIN Suppliers su ON ps.supplier_id = su.supplier_id
JOIN Products p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', COALESCE(sda.date_assigned_from, '')) = '2022';

SELECT s.staff_name, sup.supplier_name, p.product_name
FROM "Staff" s
JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON s.staff_id = co.customer_id
JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN "Products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN "Product_Suppliers" ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
   AND co.order_date BETWEEN ps.date_supplied_from AND COALESCE(ps.date_supplied_to, '9999-12-31')
JOIN "Suppliers" sup ON ps.supplier_id = sup.supplier_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = '2022';

SELECT s.staff_name
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Customer_Orders AS co ON co.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) = '2018-03'
GROUP BY s.staff_id
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CompletedOrdersMarch2018 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM Customer_Orders
    WHERE order_status_code = 'Completed'
      AND order_date >= '2018-03-01'
      AND order_date < '2018-04-01'
),
CustomerCountPerStaff AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id, s.staff_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) AS customer_count
    FROM Staff s
    -- Note: Schema does not contain a relationship between Staff and Customer_Orders
    -- This query structure represents the intended logic
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON 1=1  -- Placeholder - actual join path missing in schema
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM CompletedOrdersMarch2018)
    GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.staff_name
)
SELECT staff_name
FROM CustomerCountPerStaff
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1

votes.sql:
SELECT
    s.staff_name,
    sup.supplier_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(ps.total_value_purchased), 0) AS total_value
FROM Staff AS s
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments AS sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id
JOIN Departments AS d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN Department_Stores AS ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
JOIN Addresses AS a ON ds.store_address = a.address_details
JOIN Supplier_Addresses AS sa ON a.address_id = sa.address_id
JOIN Suppliers AS sup ON sa.supplier_id = sup.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN Product_Suppliers AS ps ON sup.supplier_id = ps.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.staff_name, sup.supplier_name;

SELECT 
    s.staff_name,
    ds.store_name,
    sup.supplier_name,
    SUM(ps.total_value_purchased) AS total_value_purchased
FROM Staff s
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON d.dept_store_id = ds.dept_store_id
JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON 1=1
